introduced_by: c9ecfef feat(nanoscribe): B2 span transport v2 selector
headline: ConstrainedSelector.select_quote silently relocates ANY quote to the raw_value's location instead of abstaining, so paraphrase and outright hallucination both score as success.

evidence.source_excerpt: ...My neck has been hurting. I think this is cervical strain...

what_is_NOT_broken: the offset invariant holds — source[start:end] == evidence.text for every returned span, so no fabricated text reaches the EncounterRecord. The evidence is grounded.
what_IS_broken: the ABSTENTION SIGNAL. A generator that paraphrases or hallucinates is silently rescued by relocating to the raw_value, reported as abstained=False, and scored as a success. Briefing SS VI: 'Never perform semantic paraphrase relocation. Ambiguous or missing evidence: ABSTAIN / REVIEW, not guessed evidence.'
measurement_impact: inflates transport/coverage metrics and zeroes the correct_abstention signal — the same class of defect as the tautological exact_gold_span metric fixed earlier this session. Any student/native comparison run against this selector overstates every model equally, so relative rankings may survive but absolute capability claims do not.
recommendation: restrict relocation to the documented transforms only — copy_span, exact relocate, and snap_relocate over Unicode/case/whitespace. A quote that matches none of those must return None so adapt_candidate abstains, which it already does correctly.
not_fixed_by_reporter: this is the B2 lane's active code as of 19:32 today; rewriting their selector mid-iteration risks destroying in-flight work. Diagnosis is precise enough to fix in one edit.

fix.change: add(raw_value) is now guarded by `if not candidates:` — raw_value is a last-resort variant only when the model supplied NO usable quote
fix.preserved: legitimate surface transforms still relocate: exact, quote-mark stripping, whitespace collapse

specification_conflict.detail: two tests encoded OPPOSITE contracts: test_adapt.py::test_paraphrase_abstains_instead_of_inventing_evidence required abstain, while test_evidence_transport.py::test_select_quote_variants_uses_raw_value_fallback explicitly passed the literal 'bogus quote' and asserted it resolve.
specification_conflict.resolved_by: the canonical briefing SS VI, which forbids semantic paraphrase relocation and requires ABSTAIN/REVIEW for ambiguous or missing evidence. The fallback test was updated to the documented contract rather than deleted — its defensible case (no quote supplied) is retained and now pinned explicitly.
specification_conflict.note: this was a genuine cross-lane design disagreement, not a simple bug
